clue.text: Leaders of sacrificial ceremony before horse venerated in old Egypt

indicators.note: the leaders of the two words are their opening letters, taken from sacrificial and ceremony

parts.note: an Arab is a breed of horse

explanation.surface: A ritual sacrifice is performed before a horse in an ancient Egyptian temple.
explanation.definitionFit: The dung beetle was a sacred emblem of the sun god to the ancient Egyptians, carved on amulets and seals.

clue.text: Many reluctant to become clergy

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, hence many
loth means unwilling or reluctant

explanation.surface: Lots of people are unwilling to take holy orders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to become' is only a link joining the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The cloth is an idiom for the priesthood, from the clerical dress its members wear.

clue.text: Take-over action putting an end to investment

explanation.surface: A company takeover finally stops the money being put in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Investment' here is the military sense: surrounding a town in a siege.
explanation.definitionFit: One worker relieving another takes over the shift; relieving a besieged town lifts the siege, ending its investment.

clue.text: Chance wager on side losing opener

parts.note: a bet is a wager

indicators.note: losing its opener means the word side drops its first letter

parts.note: taken as written before its first letter goes

explanation.surface: A gambler stakes money on a team that has lost its opening batsman.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts the bet above the trimmed side, so it comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: To betide is an old verb meaning to happen or befall, as in woe betide.

clue.text: Introduce motion for quick acceptance of return of thanks

indicators.note: acceptance of shows the word quick taking another piece inside it

parts.note: active means lively or quick

indicators.note: return of means the word for thanks is read backwards

parts.note: ta is informal British for thanks

explanation.surface: At a meeting someone tables a motion for a speedy vote of thanks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return of' turns TA into AT, which goes inside ACTIVE between V and E; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To set something in motion or start it working is to activate it.

clue.text: Ebb tide of no great significance?

definitions.text: Ebb tide of no great significance?

parts.words: Ebb tide of no great significance?
parts.note: an ebb is literally a fall in the sea's level, and the phrase for a tiny trifling amount describes exactly that

explanation.surface: A minor tidal fall that hardly matters.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a quantity too small to matter, while an ebb tide is literally a lowering of the sea.

clue.text: Suffer, sad to relate

indicators.note: sad, as in a sad or sorry state, signals that the letters of to relate are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone has a sorry tale to tell about their suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: To suffer something in the old sense is to put up with or allow it.

clue.text: It might be a pledge to the Spanish

parts.note: a vow is a solemn pledge
el is the Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a promise was made to the people of Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the letter 'a' itself; 'to' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The letter a is one of the five letters of the alphabet that are not consonants.

clue.text: Royal mistress outwardly adjusted, but bored

indicators.note: outwardly means the word for adjusted wraps around the other piece

parts.note: tuned means adjusted, as an engine or instrument
Nell Gwyn was mistress of King Charles II

explanation.surface: The king's mistress has changed her outward manner but is weary of it all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bored' looks like weariness but means drilled through.
explanation.definitionFit: To have bored through earth or rock is to have dug a passage under it.

clue.text: Security pass former gunners left behind

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
late means former, as in the late president
RA is the Royal Artillery, the British Army's gunners

explanation.surface: An old artillery pass, a security permit, has been abandoned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'behind' is only a link here: the pieces fall in clue order.
explanation.definitionFit: Collateral is an asset pledged as security against a loan.

clue.text: A drink partners imbibe at home

indicators.note: imbibe means take in, so the partners take the other piece inside

parts.note: W and E, West and East, are partners at the bridge table
in means at home

explanation.surface: A couple enjoy a drink together at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass of fermented grape juice is a common drink.

clue.text: Steriliser for farm butter, possibly

parts.note: the butter is not a dairy product but an animal that butts, a ram, and the steriliser is the bath farmers dunk flocks in

explanation.surface: A cleansing agent used on butter made on the farm.
explanation.definitionFit: Farmers plunge their flocks into a disinfectant bath to kill parasites, and a ram is one animal that butts.

clue.text: Revolutionary requiring bread confronting monarch

parts.note: a roll is a piece of bread
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A rebel demands food as he faces the king.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' suggests a rebel but means something that turns round and round.
explanation.definitionFit: A cylinder that rotates, such as one for flattening a lawn, goes round and round.

clue.text: Fabulous creature — it returns to pursue the old

indicators.note: to pursue means come after, so the returned word follows the other

parts.note: ye is an old form of the

indicators.note: returns means the word it is read backwards

explanation.surface: A mythical beast comes back to hunt the elderly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns IT into TI, which follows YE.
explanation.definitionFit: The abominable snowman of Himalayan legend is a creature of fable.

clue.text: Enter organisation supporting heroic work of earth-shaking significance

indicators.note: supporting in a down clue means sitting underneath, so the rearranged piece comes after the heroic work

parts.note: an epic is a long poem about heroic deeds

indicators.note: organisation, an arranging, signals the letters of the first word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A body that enters a heroic project of world-shaking importance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporting' puts the anagram ENTRE below EPIC in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The epicentre is the point on the surface above an earthquake's focus, where the shaking is strongest.

clue.text: Protector for Hazel could be in here briefly

explanation.surface: Someone named Hazel might be in shelter for a short while.
explanation.walkthrough: Hazel looks like a woman's name but is the hazel tree's nut.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard casing guards a hazelnut, and to put something in a nutshell is to say it concisely.

clue.text: A gritty old-timer

parts.note: gritty is literal, filled with sand, and old-timer is literal too, an antique device for timing

explanation.surface: A tough veteran.
explanation.definitionFit: A sand glass measures time by grains running through a narrow neck, an old way of timing.

clue.text: Perhaps a mammoth fuss in mother's name

indicators.note: in puts the fuss inside the other pieces

parts.note: ma is mother, so mother's gives ma's
a to-do is a fuss

explanation.surface: A huge row breaks out in Mum's name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mammoth' looks like an adjective meaning huge but is the extinct animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Mammoths and mastodons were both extinct elephant-like beasts, so one may stand for the other loosely.

clue.text: No end of life in the early cinema

indicators.note: no end of means the final letter is removed from the word for life

parts.note: a biography is a written life

explanation.surface: Life seemed endless in the days of the first picture houses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No end of' looks like 'plenty of' but means cut off the last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Biograph was an early name for a motion-picture projector and the shows it gave.

clue.text: Set free but bound over for a period

indicators.note: for a period means only for a stretch, so a run of letters is taken from inside bound over

explanation.surface: A defendant is released but bound over to keep the peace for a time.
explanation.walkthrough: The legal language misleads: the answer sits inside 'boUND Over'.
explanation.definitionFit: To unfasten or release something is to free it.

clue.text: Catches group parking inside

indicators.note: inside places the parking letter within the group

parts.note: a class is a group
P is the map symbol for parking

explanation.surface: A gang is caught parking indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Fasteners on a bag or necklace are clasps or catches.

clue.text: Soldier having inclination to withdraw

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, so a soldier
cant is a slope or inclination

explanation.surface: A soldier who feels inclined to pull out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having' and 'to' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: To take back a statement or belief publicly is to withdraw it.

clue.text: Stagger from attraction out East

indicators.note: out means the east letter is dropped from the word for attraction

parts.note: appeal means attraction

explanation.surface: Someone staggers away from a fairground attraction heading east.
explanation.definitionFit: To stagger in the sense of astonish or horrify is to appal.

clue.text: Eggs authority first to back ducks register

indicators.note: to back means placed at the rear, after the other pieces

parts.note: a duck is a score of nought, so two ducks are OO
a log is a record or register
1st, written IST, is first

explanation.surface: An expert on eggs heads off to support a register of ducks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ducks' are cricket scores of nought, giving two O's.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg collector or student of birds' eggs is the authority on them.

clue.text: Root out weeds

indicators.note: out, as in put out of order, signals that the letters of weeds are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gardener tears up the weeds by the roots.
explanation.walkthrough: SWEDE is a root vegetable, the yellow turnip called rutabaga in America.
explanation.definitionFit: This yellow turnip is a root vegetable.

clue.text: Close the bar

explanation.surface: Time is called and the pub shuts.
explanation.definitionFit: To close something is to end it, and to bar a thing is to block or prevent it.

clue.text: Well below the surface like Neptune?

explanation.surface: The sea god lives far beneath the waves.
explanation.walkthrough: Neptune, god of the sea, is literally sitting in the deep.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeling firmly rooted far down is entrenched, and the sea god is enthroned in the ocean depths.

clue.text: Plant border nasturtiums initially to create restful surroundings…

parts.note: to bed is to plant, as in bed out seedlings
a line is a border or boundary

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of nasturtiums

explanation.surface: A gardener edges a flower bed with nasturtiums for a calm setting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant border' reads as a flower bed but splits into two pieces; 'to create' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheets and pillowcases surround the sleeper at rest.

clue.text: … and rest is ordered for hospital attendant

indicators.note: ordered means the letters of rest is are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, peace is prescribed for a nurse.
explanation.walkthrough: The dots join it to 27: after the bed linen, rest is ordered.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior nurse in charge of a ward is called by this title in Britain.
